title: CppCon 2016: Dan Saks “extern c: Talking to C Programmers about C++”
summary: Dan Saks's CppCon 2016 talk on why C programmers resist C++ and how to talk to them about it. He argues that persuasion rarely works by arguing and examines the culture gap between the two communities.
why: Recommended in C versus C++ and embedded threads as the expert view on adoption and persuasion.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

quote.text: The mentioned cppcon presentation by Dan Saks is awesome. Highly recommend watching even if you are not interested in C or C++
